title: Geneve: Add new GCP options.
description:
Add support for three new GCP-specific options:

- Timestamp (0x0f)
- Network Stable ID (0x10)
- Primary IPv4 Address (0x11)

Similar to https://gitlab.com/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/6559.

Manually verified in a fresh debian container - will attach example pcap and output.
